sentences.text: pleased to issue a writ of Mandamus or any other appropriate writ or direction and/or order in the nature of writ directing the Respondents to forthwith implement and make the payment of amount of compensation as per orders dated 14th September,2015 and 14th July, 2016."

2. On 28/08/2023, we had passed a detailed order wherein we had granted 2 weeks time to CIDCO to deposit the amount of Rs. 53,56,593/- and Rs. 18,31,772/- with the Special Land Acquisition Officer towards payment to the Petitioner under the Award which forms the subject matter of the present Petition.
We had kept the above matter today for directions and to see if the said order was complied with.

3. Today, when the matter is called out, we are informed that the amount of Rs. 53,56,593/- and Rs.
18,31,772/- has been deposited by CIDCO with the Special Land Acquisition Officer.

Ms. Bane, on instructions, stated that these amounts will now be transferred to the credit of the Execution Proceedings initiated by the Petitioner being Darkhast No. 33 of 2017 and Darkhast No. 7 of 2017,
pending before the Civil Judge, Sr.Division, Alibaug.
Ms. Bane, on instructions, stated that these amounts shall be transferred to the credit of the said proceedings within a period of 2 weeks from today.
OCTOBER 16, 2023 Yugandhara Patil 10-WP-10349-2022.doc 4.
Once these amounts are transferred to the credit of the said proceedings, the Petitioner herein is free to make an application for the withdrawal of his share of the said amounts.
If such an application is made, the same shall be decided on its own merits and in accordance with law.
5. The Writ Petition is accordingly disposed.
No order as to costs.
6. This order will be digitally signed by the Private Secretary/ Personal Assistant of this Court.
All concerned will act on production by fax or email of a digitally signed copy of this order.

[ M.M.
SATHAYE, J.] [ B. P. COLABAWALLA, J.]
OCTOBER 16, 2023 Signed by: Yugandhara Patil Yugandhara Patil
